_note: S2: Hinglish / romanised-Hindi / Devanagari product words mapped to canonical catalogue tokens. Data file, not code - extend here, not in search.js. A roman word maps to the token the engine should match; words already native to the catalogue (kurta, kurti, saree, lehenga, chappal, tiffin, mojari) need no entry. Devanagari keys are matched on the raw query before non-latin stripping.
_mapped_stopwords_note: cheap/good/best are in the STOP list, so sasta/accha/sabse act as modifiers (they never become product tokens) - same behaviour as their English equivalents.
_rasoi_note: 'kitchen' is a context modifier in the engine (it never scores on its own), so rasoi maps to the concrete product word 'utensils'.
